newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen moving down amid weak sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen moving down amid weak sentiment.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may move downwards slightly on Sunday as market sentiment remains depressed over a crisis in the banking sector, brokers said.

"The market may move a little downwards amid weak market sentiment. The fund-starved financial institutions are unlikely to support the market as they refuse funding in a falling market," said broker Khurshid Alam.
The all-share price index closed 7.5 points or 0.72 percent down at 1,014.7 on turnover of 42 million taka on Sunday.
